notes: Historical representative early-operation1963 Big Rock Point principal station exterior: partially buried spherical containment shell with equatorial rim/vertical outer ribs/crown walkway and exterior access ladder, tapered red-and-white striped stack, attached tall turbine hall with clerestory, lower two-storey front office/control block with deep vertical piers and glazing, shallow entrance canopy, and intrinsic low shoreward cooling-water building/short connecting service volume. Exclude interiors and process equipment, switchyard/powerlines, detached ancillary sheds, parking/roads/landscape/lake/shore riprap, people/vehicles/lettering and current spent-fuel storage/marker.
